note: Set A is more faithful to the geometric layout, correctly binding grid spacings to grid numbers (e.g., 5 to 6) and placing the 8'-8 5/8" column dimension in the correct vertical zone (First Floor to T.O. Steel). Set B hallucinates the location of the 8'-8 5/8" dimension (claiming it is from Grade to First Floor, which is 2'-4") and misbinds grid dimensions to a detail callout (C4) instead of grid lines. Although Set B captures the 11'-4" elevation and 32'-0" width which Set A misses, the geometric errors in B are more severe.
remarks: Set B's claim that the 8'-8 5/8" height is from Grade to First Floor is a critical engineering error given the 2'-4" floor height. Both sets struggle with the 9'-0" dimension conditions (often attributing it to Grade level instead of First Floor), but Set A has correct claims for it as well.
